productionEndpointPolicy: Dedicated production worker endpoint must reach its Bearer-authenticated handler from the website; do not alter website protection. Verify worker-only platform protection settings before deployment.

environment.name: SEO_SYNC_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
environment.source: Secure official Supabase project service credential; no value in this file

environment.name: CRON_SECRET
environment.source: New independent random worker secret, at least 32 characters; no value generated here

websiteEnvironment.name: SEO_WORKER_URL
websiteEnvironment.source: Actual stable worker production URL ending /api/sync; never predict it from the proposed project name

websiteEnvironment.name: SEO_WORKER_CRON_SECRET
websiteEnvironment.source: Same worker CRON_SECRET; never an admin signing secret or database credential

separation.previewCredentials: Do not copy production worker secrets into Preview or Development
separation.workerServiceKey: Same Supabase privilege class as existing service_role; dedicated environment name is not a reduced database privilege
separation.authSecrets: Preserve existing website authentication configuration; do not rotate it implicitly
separation.platformBypass: No bypass secret is currently supported by the website worker adapter; resolve worker-only platform access explicitly
